command: cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; xqaudio-capture /tmp/c70-search.wav 6 >audio-search.log 2>&1 & ap=$!; printf "XQ_NEWGAME\nXQ_MOVE h2e2\n" > /run/voice-display.in; n=0; until grep -q "INJECT MOVE_PASS\|INJECT MOVE_FAIL" gui-gather-verify.log; do sleep 1; n=$((n+1)); test "$n" -lt 90 || break; done; wait "$ap"; ar=$?; cat audio-search.log; tail -24 gui-gather-verify.log; test "$ar" -eq 0 && grep -q "INJECT MOVE_PASS" gui-gather-verify.log
cd /tmp/voice-gui-display; printf "XQ_NEWGAME\n" > /run/voice-display.in; sleep 3; tail -5 gui-gather-verify.log; date +%s; sleep 2; date +%s
